title: Add publish-vscode-extension action
description:
## Summary
- Adds a new composite GitHub Action (`publish-vscode-extension`) that publishes pre-built `.vsix` files to the VS Marketplace or Open VSX Registry
- Supports configurable registry URL, skip-duplicate, and dry-run modes
- Includes a test workflow and sample extension fixture for CI validation

title: Use `windows-latest` not `windows-latest-8x`
description: Spoke with @jmcphers and @jspiewak about this Air's release step was getting stopped in its tracks when trying to sign the windows binary. I captured proof that all windows-latest-8x runners were busy at the time: It looked like some long running Positron builds were going at this time, and this isn't the first time this has tripped me up. Since both `windows-latest-8x` and `windows-latest` are managed by GitHub, we determined there should be no change in security by moving to the more available `windows-latest` runner.
